excluded_fields.leg.stdout, stderr, monitor_stdout, moni: Local file names; artifact hashes and structured telemetry are retained

limitations: CPU legs ran on six efficiency cores of an Intel Core i5-13500 at nice 19 under a six-CPU quota, on a server that also runs other workloads.
GPU legs shared the GPU with another workload's idle compute context, admitted by process ID; every gate reading before a GPU leg showed at most 5% utilization.
One GPU, an NVIDIA RTX 4000 SFF Ada Generation with 48 multiprocessors under its 70 W power limit; other GPUs are not measured.
Batch-1 queries only; bulk throughput is not measured.
The GPU competitors ran with FP16 graphs, CUDA graph replay and TensorRT builder level 5, not with their libraries' default settings.

ONNX Runtime CUDA's FP16 graph of modernbert-embed-base keeps the rotary positions and angles in FP32, because FP16 holds every whole number only up to 2,048.

limitations: CPU legs ran on six efficiency cores of an Intel Core i5-13500 at nice 19 under a six-CPU quota, on a server that also runs other workloads.
The modernbert-embed cases longer than 2,048 tokens ran on the GPU only.
Batch-1 queries only; bulk throughput is not measured.

PyTorch ran modernbert-embed-base with both attention masks of a case's shape made before its timed calls and with no mask on the layers that see the whole text; the model's own forward makes the masks at every call.
